title: Interest account cancellation succeeded
description: This event occurs when an account cancellation is successfully processed with product interest engine.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Unique ID used to identify the program in the Pismo platform APIs.

account_id.title: Pismo's account identifier
account_id.description: Account ID generated by Pismo's platform that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

external_account_cancellation_id.title: External account cancellation ID
external_account_cancellation_id.description: Customer-defined identifier for account cancellation operation

external_account_id.title: Client's account identifier
external_account_id.description: External account ID informed by the client that uniquely identifies an account within your organization.

cancellation_date.title: Cancellation date
cancellation_date.description: Date when account was cancelled by client

gross_withdrawn_amount.title: Gross Amount Redeemed
gross_withdrawn_amount.description: Gross Value redeemed from account due to account cancellation request

net_withdrawn_amount.title: Net withdrawn amount
net_withdrawn_amount.description: Net amount withdrawn from account due to account cancellation request

created_at.title: Created at
created_at.description: Timestamp when the success event was generated by the worker, in "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" format (local server time, no timezone offset). Not a date-only or ISO-8601 date-time value.
